name: fam-08-write
prompt: In go.mod, make the Go version line explicit (go 1.26) and add a .go-version file containing 1.26 so tooling reads the pinned toolchain. Nothing else changes.
check:
test -f .go-version && grep -q 'go 1.26' go.mod || { echo 'precursor change missing' >&2; exit 1; }
go build ./... && go test -count=1 ./...
